ideas.pitch: An automated OSINT investigation pipeline that ingests domain and IP artifacts, builds interactive attack-surface relationship graphs, and flags exposed internal credentials.
ideas.title: OSINT-Grapher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the OSINT and Web Security categories of the CTF and borrows graph intelligence patterns from the winning AML risk detection platform to visually map adversary footprints for judges.

ideas.pitch: A static analysis tool designed to detect weak cryptographic implementations, predictable IV usage, and insecure key management in source code repositories.
ideas.title: CryptoLeak-Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the Cryptography track by automating vulnerability discovery, leveraging repository reporting patterns seen in past winning security tools.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined binary exploitation visualization utility that steps through stack frames, tracks register mutations, and detects buffer overflow vectors in raw ELF binaries.
ideas.title: PwnSim-Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the Binary Exploitation (Pwn) and Reverse Engineering tracks by offering deep technical inspection mechanics reminiscent of hard engineering wins.

ideas.pitch: An automated steganography detection and extraction suite that applies statistical frequency analysis and LSB scraping to uncover hidden payloads in image and audio files.
ideas.title: StegoExtract Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Steganography and Digital Forensics challenges by implementing specialized algorithmic checks rather than generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-triage packet capture and disk image forensics tool that correlates network anomaly logs with file system timelines to reconstruct breach narratives.
ideas.title: NetPulse Forensics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly serves the Digital Forensics category by combining multi-source artifact parsing into a unified, judge-friendly reporting dashboard.
